blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Cavite police arrested four robbery suspects in Trece Martires City on Saturday. The Cavite Police Provincial Office (CPPO) its police operatives, armed with an arrest warrant apprehended a suspect in Barangay Conchu around 10 a.m. Police intelligence reportedly linked the suspect to a robbery group operating in the Calabarzon (Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal, Quezon) and neighboring regions. The three other individuals were also arrested after police allegedly found them in possession of one .45-caliber pistol, one 9mm pistol, two .38-caliber revolvers, 17 rounds of live ammunition and two hand grenades.
